courses.synopsis: Specification and standardization: Interchangeable manufacture, preferred sizes, limits and fits. Fundamentals of measurement: length, standards, sources of error, angular measurements; comparators, autocollimator, indirect measurements, straightness and flatness testing. Surface finish. Fundamentals of gauge design. Screws threads, specification, tolerancing, gauging and measurements. Statistical methods of process control. Principles of planning and tools design. Industrial health and safety. Ergonomics. Elements of cleaner production and applications in mechanical engineering.
